title: GateProofRecord
description: Assembled by the final `Gate: proof` job from the per-leg fragments (or produced locally by `pnpm gate-proof`). A record committed to the repository is a snapshot of its PARENT commit, informational only. SC-002 evidence is green `Gate: proof` on the PR head plus the uploaded sanitised artifact.

snapshotOf.description: 'head' for the CI artifact; 'parent' if the record is committed (it cannot describe its own commit)

image.description: Rendering image reference (tag and digest) used for browser gates

gates.description: Coverage (checked by the final job): gate ids equal the `Gate: <id>` jobs in ci.yml minus {proof, all}, equal the matrix gate list, equal the gates/plants/* directories, equal the fragment set; ids pairwise distinct (asserted by the script; uniqueItems alone only rejects identical objects).

patternMatched.description: the plant-unique token was found in the planted run's output

tokenAbsentFromCleanOutput.description: the plant-unique token is absent from the leg's clean run output

excerpt.description: Sanitised: roots replaced by <repo>/<home>; any _authToken value rewritten to <redacted>.

cleanExit.description: the leg's own clean run of the gate command

localWorktreeCleanAfterRestore.description: local runs only: `git status --porcelain` empty in the throwaway worktree after restore
